name: Zhanox
description: Zhanox was an Outer Rim Territories mining world located in the Anoat sector. Its surface was covered by stony spires, between which were rubble-strewn valleys. The mines of Zhanox were overseen by Ugnaughts, while Human colonists inhabited the world's valleys. The Bespin Wing Guard member Alec Mard hailed from Zhanox.
